outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Employment Law page
outreach_draft.body:
Jennifer, I was reviewing your current site and noticed that Employment Law, Trademark Law, and Small Business & Non-Profit Law all share the same general Services page. Those clients arrive with very different questions, urgency, and reasons for choosing counsel. A focused Employment Law page could give employees and employers a clearer journey from the moment they land on the site, with the relevant situations, guidance and next step in one place. It would also give Google a more focused service context and make it easier for AI systems to understand that part of the practice distinctly. I’d use Employment Law as the first mockup because it is clearly offered today and represents a very different client conversation from trademark and business counsel. I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
